name: memory-server-worker
description: Personal persistent memory MCP server backed by Cloudflare Agent Memory.

scripts.build: npm -w memory-worker run build && npm -w memory-ui run build
scripts.typecheck: npm -w memory-worker run typecheck && npm -w memory-ui run typecheck && npm -w allenlim-memory-server run typecheck
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.test: npm -w memory-worker run test && npm -w memory-ui run test && npm -w allenlim-memory-server run test && npm run test:artifact-verifier && npm run verify:plugins
